Good morning, I hope you're doing well, I just got back from the most amazing holiday in Tuscany and I'm still feeling the heat, anyway, to the point, I'd like to hire the Regent for a period drama shoot, we need it on 11 September 2027, from 10am until 6:30 pm, could you bring it to Studio 9, Quarry Lane and collect it from there afterwards?

Best wishes,
Jasper Sedgewick-Rowe
